coreIdea: K-map groups = powers of 2. Larger group = fewer literals. Essential PI = uniquely covers some minterm, MUST be included. Don't-cares are optional helpers.
mustRememberFormulas: Group of 2^k cells → term with (n-k) literals
Essential PI = only PI covering some minterm — mandatory inclusion
Don't-cares: use if helpful for bigger groups, never required to be covered

patternRecognitionTable.seeThis: minterms/don't-cares given, asked minimal SOP or EPI count
'is F independent of variable X' asked
self-dual check, POS form, or circuit-to-expression conversion

commonTrapsQuickList: Groups must be powers of 2 — never 3, 5, 6, etc.
Always check EVERY minterm for essential-PI status before finalizing
Minimize FIRST before checking variable independence — a non-minimal expression can mislead
POS groups the 0-cells; SOP groups the 1-cells — don't mix up
highYieldPyqLessons: K-map minimization (12/16) is nearly the whole topic — get the essential-PI-first-then-cover-rest workflow completely automatic.
This topic directly feeds Circuit Output (combinational circuit analysis) — the same grouping skill applies there too.
